Preserve original regional weights and facility coefficients without renormalization, moisture correction or capacity scaling. Map positive operating kg to the independently inspected complete Swiss residual-landfill operation and positive facility units to its complete 300000 m3 facility at 1600 kg/m3. Construction, use and aftercare have the inspected 5/30/40-year source phases. These components are separate from direct waste-specific leachate releases and from stabilization; add no second operating or construction burden. Source Swiss operation uses 0.027 MJ diesel, 0.0000563 kWh electricity and 0.0056776 MJ other heat per kg. UVEK uses the matching diesel/electricity quantities, 0.00604 MJ oil heat and an additional 0.000202 MJ waste-heat release. Its facility uses bitumen rather than source pitch, a different concrete supply and explicit construction freight; Swiss supply replaces other regional energy/material mixtures. These are disclosed whole-component background proxies, not separate pitch, concrete or heat correspondences. Cement uses the inspected complete Swiss unspecified-cement product; preserve incoming kg while disclosing blend, geography, market/freight and vintage differences. Hydrated-cement waste uses its dedicated Swiss service with the independently verified negative-source/positive-target factor -1; this is disposal demand rather than a cement-recovery credit. Preserve source mass without inferring water or dry-mass equivalence to the native 0%-water label. Supplier freight, land, energy, treatment boundaries and LCIA scores differ; equivalence is not established. Source references are -1 kg except the two active blast-furnace-slag 3.9 cut-off profiles, whose +1 references and burdens are retained with factor +1. No empty-stock inference, absolute value or blanket sign inversion is authorized. Real releases are retained; the explicitly marked hazardous/non-hazardous waste, total-waste-mass and organic-carbon inventory indicators remain where supported, otherwise only those indicators may be omitted with warnings under the standing policy. Exact published flow UUIDs normalize older names to canonical ecoinvent labels with unchanged unit/compartment; original labels and CAS identifiers remain audited. Approved native water proxies retain their chemical/receiving-compartment warnings. Preserve caller signs, uncertainty, formulas, metadata, foreground suppliers, production and separately listed emissions. Source internal uncertainty and formulas are not reconstructed. Score/export all returned helpers. No upstream incineration, wastewater treatment, collection freight, recovered product or substitution credit is added. Expanded modern profiles retain their own construction and operation inputs rather than inheriting older aggregate component totals. Scoped supplier corrections use refinery bitumen for the construction pitch commodity, normal ready-mix concrete for 25 MPa concrete, full PVC material from regional storage rather than polymerization-only service, and the existing curated RER heavy-fuel-oil industrial-heat proxy for the qualified non-natural-gas heat commodity. Pitch feedstock/allocation, concrete strength and mix, PVC technology and delivery, heat fuel/production mix and regional background differ; these are screening proxies, not reconstructed market mixes. Separate pipe extrusion remains separate; no monomer input or second polymerization is added. The user approved native-only residual-landfill classification for 36 generic from-dump transformation records: preserve the signed 5.7143e-5 m2/kg and the generic canonical label, without adopting the native operating inventory's 6.25e-5 m2/kg or inferring occupation-years. Every applied native refinement has its own warning. Other dump classes and arbitrary caller flows are not reclassified. No version, patch, system-model or inverse fallback is inferred.

identity.name: treatment of electric arc furnace dust, residual material landfill

limitations: Exact3.9cutoff steel-residue reconstruction: retain every original market share and freight row, including source lognormal uncertainty and separate geographic rows, without renormalization, distance/payload/moisture scaling or invented recovery credits. Rail country/fuel/traction mixes, fleet/load, geography, vintage and native internal uncertainty differ; no air-freight or bulk-cargo substitution. Waste-specific landfill helpers retain every direct release with signed quantity, uncertainty, exact ecoinvent3.10 unit and receiving compartment, including long-term groundwater. Same published flow UUIDs normalize only the two Strontium labels to Strontium II. Preserve stabilization cement, every regional operation/facility/hydrated-cement-disposal row and their original uncertainty. Complete independently reviewed Swiss native components replace source regional backgrounds; cement blend, energy, operation, construction, aftercare, allocation and disposal moisture can differ. Preserve source mass; native0%-water cement-disposal wording does not prove equal source moisture. Only genuine positive-reference production-only Recycled Content cut-off stocks receive explicit zero-burden helpers. Retain the signed stock input inside each separate recovery handover, without introducing recycling burdens, avoided virgin-metal burdens or nonzero recovery credits. Caller signs, supported uncertainty, formulas and separately listed emissions remain. Score differences are unquantified; no reverse or cross-system-model routes or other-release approvals are added.
